value.rationale: The work determines the complete set of maximum-cardinality inclusion-minimal dominating configurations on the canonical two-row grid strip, including two genuinely non-independent extremizer families occurring only at even lengths. It yields the exact leading coefficient of the minimal-domination polynomial for every length, going beyond the known upper cardinality and the known total count; the parity transition is structural, not a one-off sample.
